board: NUCLEO-F446RE MB1136, full board with ST-LINK

driver.interface: IN1/IN2; both inputs are PWM-capable; firmware owns slew, timeout and re-arm

power.tether_input_class: 40..160 VDC candidate; surface fuse, precharge and E-stop required
power.camera_rail: D24V22F12 12 V reserve; measure real camera/video load

notes: This profile is a nominal R16 pin allocation for packaging and harness work; no BIN has been flashed or hardware-tested.
R16 keeps the R12 traction and encoder map. TIM1 pins PA8..PA11 are reserved as four independent camera-driver inputs.
PC6/PC7 are assigned to the optional RunCam UART; remove this harness if the selected camera has no control UART.
Encoder outputs need verified 3.3 V levels; no 5 V directly to the MCU is assumed safe.
DRV8871 R1 values and current limits are bench targets until the actual carrier revision is measured.
A surface hardware contactor/precharge/discharge path and tether interlock are mandatory; firmware is not the HV isolator.
